title: Agent skill: choose and check structural, heat and flow models
body:
## What and why

Refs #481. Adds a bundled modelling skill that guides structural, heat and fluid setup, independent estimates, load/BC activity, balance checks and refinement. It includes original axial-rod and steady-conductor recipes with a verification worksheet.

The fluid guidance now states the limits explicitly: aim for Ma ≲ 0.1; τ must exceed ½ and stability degrades near it; regularized collision helps stability; the automatic time step targets Ma ≈ 0.087 and τ ≤ 1. Density variation is identified as compressibility error to investigate before trusting pressure or heat-rate results.

## Validation

Revision `04e3c73b01bd28ff1222b3cb68b662d139e78ea4` is a single logical skill commit rebased onto `3751d3bb93676aa49d1a18c438424be88162ac03`.

- Statements checked against current LBM setup/solve code, model.step.create schema and collision documentation.
- Manual simplification review, formatting, relative-link existence and diff checks pass.
- Both unchanged reference recipes execute successfully with the cached, tested diagnostics CLI artifact from `cb89c561`. That branch does not change solver/FEM numerics. This is recipe execution, not new physical validation.
- No Rust code changed; no new crate suite, GPU run or full workspace gate was needed.

## Historical demonstration

The original 33-second clip shows a synthetic conductor patch and the held-hot bracket in a single air domain: 5 mm spacing, a 45-second physical transient, CPU solve with three threads and an RTX 4090 Vulkan viewport. Its density-variation warnings remain material: 15.9% at dt = 0.25 s and 3.5% at dt = 0.125 s. These are coarse smoke/sensitivity demonstrations, with no steady-state, heat-rate-accuracy or two-fluid-exchanger claim.

The reused executable was built at `99d8536`; its production app/engine/solver source matches the original branch base `7d9c027d71` (the earlier Rust difference is updater tests). It was not rebuilt at the skill commit. The attachments remain historical evidence, not a fresh native capture of this text revision.

Native GitHub attachments (original capture revision `443160e0bbc3c6a8f8310c1366bb6e593eb6eda6`; receipts verify the original SHA-256 and byte sizes):

- [conduction-check.png](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/89893403-069c-40b4-af5a-46ec8464aa75)
- [heated-flow-check.png](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2597656d-2d5b-4cfe-80a4-61490c66da9f)
- [modelling-checks.mp4](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9b454386-6d65-43c0-b588-7e581ed06b0d)


## Limits

The skill guides modelling decisions; it does not automatically choose or run commands, establish material data, or certify engineering accuracy. The examples are verification exercises with stated assumptions. GPU LES/fan support and coupled-exchanger capability must be checked against implemented and verified behavior. MCP prompt delivery is the separate stacked PR #720.
